subject: Closure: Meridian Health ticketed prompt-output purge + proof of removal
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@meridianhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Bennett <alice.bennett@meridianhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Meridian request: ticketed purge of prompt outputs, logs and KV cache (ticket 4527)

Karthik —

Thanks for taking this. Meridian needs formal confirmation that all prompt-output artifacts and ephemeral logs generated under tenant meridian-prod for the period 2025-08-01 -> 2027-05-01 have been purged per our retention clause (Section 4.2). Scope: prompt-output blobs, per-request logs, ephemeral KV cache entries, and any derived embeddings created as part of the assistant pipeline.

Can Redwood run the ticketed purge and provide:
- a short runbook of steps executed
- an S3/object key list showing deletion (or a stub if objects are immutable)
- signed attestation once complete

Ticket is OPS-4527 on our side. We are requesting completion by end-of-day Friday if possible because of an audit.

Thanks,
Sanjay
Meridian Health — Security Program Manager
[Attachment: meridian-request-4527.pdf]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Meridian request: ticketed purge of prompt outputs, logs and KV cache (ticket 4527)

Sanjah —

We can run this as a ticketed wipe. Quick confirmation of scope prior to execution:
1) Prompt-output blobs stored in customer bucket meridian-prod-outputs (object prefix: outputs/2025-08-01_to_2027-05-01/)
2) Per-request logs in redwood-requests (log keys annotated with tenant_id=meridian-prod) — these will be removed from hot storage and tombstoned in cold archives if applicable
3) Ephemeral KV cache for meridian-prod (in-memory shards + on-disk swap); we will evict and zeroize relevant shards
4) Derived embeddings stored in embeddings-store/meridian/* (delete objects)

Plan: Marissa will coordinate the runbook and ops steps, Ben will collect the deletion evidence (S3 keys + run logs). We'll produce an attestation PDF signed by Redwood operations and include a minimal evidence bundle.

We aim to execute Friday 2027-05-21 09:00-11:00 PT and deliver artifacts by 17:00 PT. If you need an earlier window let us know.

Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: plan-stub.txt]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Meridian request: ticketed purge of prompt outputs, logs and KV cache (ticket 4527)

Ben / Karthik —

Draft runbook (high level):
- Pre-check: snapshot current manifest for meridian-prod (manifest-v1.json) and capture audit log cursor (log_cursor: 2027-05-19T10:58Z)
- Lock: place a tenant-level write lock for a 30-minute maintenance window
- Delete: issue coordinated deletions: outputs prefix -> S3 delete objects; embeddings keyspace -> delete via embeddings-service; request logs -> redact tenant_id entries and run archival tombstone where necessary; KV shards -> evict + zeroize + rotate keys
- Verify: run list-objects to confirm 0 matches for targeted prefixes; generate s3-keys-removed-stub.txt
- Evidence packaging: attestation PDF with runbook, time-stamped CLI logs, and a checksummed list of deleted keys
- Post: lift write lock and emit audit event with run id OPS-4527-RUN-01

Risks: If objects are in immutable backup tier, we will mark as "expunged from active store" and include backup retention window details in attestation. That is acceptable per contract clause 4.2.

Ben — take ownership of evidence bundle. I'll schedule the run for Fri 2027-05-21 09:00 PT.

Marissa
Senior Ops Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@meridianhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 11:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Meridian request: ticketed purge of prompt outputs, logs and KV cache (ticket 4527)

Sanjah / team —

Execution completed for OPS-4527-RUN-01 (window 09:00-09:28 PT). Summary:
- Deleted ~14,320 objects under outputs/2025-08-01_to_2027-05-01/ from meridian-prod-outputs (see s3-keys-removed-stub.txt attached)
- Evicted and zeroized 12 KV shards (shard ids: 7,8,11,13,14, etc.)
- Redacted tenant_id entries from request logs and issued archival tombstones where cold-archival retention prevented deletion from backups (listed in attestation)
- Removed 1,842 derived embeddings for meridian-prod
- Audit event OPS-4527-RUN-01 recorded; CLI run logs stored with checksum f1d2d2f924e986ac86fdf7b36c94bcdf32

Attached: MH-erase-ticket-4527-runbook.pdf, s3-keys-removed-stub.txt, attestation-meridian-signed.pdf

Please confirm receipt. We will upload the full evidence bundle to the shared Meridian SFTP folder and provide a DocuSign-ready attestation if you need an additional signature line.

— Ben
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MH-erase-ticket-4527-runbook.pdf]

From: Alice Bennett <alice.bennett@meridianhealth.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@meridianhealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Meridian request: ticketed purge of prompt outputs, logs and KV cache (ticket 4527) — confirmation

Ben / Karthik —

Received the runbook and attestation. Thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple of clarifying notes for the audit pack:
- We accept the archival-tombstone explanation for objects in immutable tier; please include the retention class and estimated expiry date for those backups in the final bundle.
- Can you add a single line in the attestation that states: "No live prompt-output artifacts remain accessible to Meridian production workloads after OPS-4527-RUN-01" — we will include that in our compliance packet.

If you can update the attestation with that sentence and send the final PDF + link to the evidence SFTP we will mark this ticket closed on our side.

Thanks — Alice
Compliance Lead | Meridian Health
